sents.d: A consistent editing system saves hours per project over time.
Editing is usually the most time-consuming part of the job, and inconsistent habits — starting from scratch each time, disorganized project files, no color grading system — make it worse.

scenes.heading: Start every edit from a template

sents.d: Building templates for common project types (a title sequence, lower thirds, a standard color grade starting point) means each new edit starts from a proven foundation instead of a blank timeline.

Organizing footage into a consistent folder structure during import, and batching similar tasks (all color grading, then all audio mixing) rather than switching between tasks constantly, typically cuts editing time significantly without reducing quality.

take: Templates, tidy folders and batching cut editing time.
